_comment: Operator-curated feed of OPEC+ production announcements. This agent deliberately does not scrape or summarize news with AI (see README) — announcements are structured, dated entries an analyst adds here as they are made public. Copy this file to opec-announcements.json and keep it updated; the agent tracks the last-processed id in its own storage, so appending new entries at the end is always safe.

announcements.summary: OPEC+ agrees to an additional voluntary production cut starting February.
